title.narrative: Supply Chains in Türkiye: Addressing Sustainability through Deeper Integration with European Value Chains

description.narrative: The Action will comprise a programme divided into five related and mutually reinforcing components. The EUR 17 million in grant funding from the EU will leverage up to EUR 170 million from the EBRD and partner financial institutions (¿Partners¿), thereby offering a leverage effect of 11x.Given that supply chain finance is not yet common in Türkiye, EU funding will be critical in ensuring that adequate technical assistance is available during project structuring and implementation. Above all, EU support will enable the Action to deliver ambitious sustainability objectives. This will be facilitated by offering financial incentives and non-financial assistance to Turkish SMEs and midcaps willing to take on a commitment to introduce ESG standards in their operations, to become more environmentally friendly, socially responsible and better governed businesses. While the Action targets predominantly the SME sector, it will also provide support to Turkish midcaps. The share of the latter group in the total population of beneficiary companies will not exceed 1/3. The support to midcaps is deemed important as they can serve as a valuable facilitator for the EBRD to extend its reach and volume in the supply chain finance space. Participation of midcaps, being slightly larger but also more visible companies, can help create a stronger demonstration effect and awareness in the market. While SMEs form the majority of suppliers in the value chains supported by the Action, the inclusion of mid-caps will make attracting the interest of prospective partner banks easier as banks are also interested in working with this segment of companies.
